Complete [[Aurora Glade]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Attune to and use the Henge Portal in the Aurora Glade before the [[White Mantle]] can do the same.
* *BONUS* Kill the [[Demagogue]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Aurora Glade#Walkthrough|Aurora Glade]] mission.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;Zaishen Mission
: ''"We, the Shining blade, cannot allow the portal to the [[Henge of Denravi]] to fall into the White Mantle's hands. We beseech earnest heroes to hasten to the Aurora Glade in the [[Maguuma Jungle]] and prevent any such atrocity."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''
